title: 16 第16章 灵液17 第17章 强买
content_zh:
“护卫大人，这家伙敢在天香坊抢东西，明显是在挑战天香坊的威严，还望护卫大人给我做主！”
中年胖子一脸凄惨的说道，但是眼中却闪着狡黠的光芒。
那带头的护卫看了一眼林轩，见到他身上没有什么厉害的灵力波动，随即冷笑一声：“来人，拿下！”
说完，他还对着胖子使了个眼色，中年胖子嘴角露出不易察觉的笑容，同时，四个天香坊护卫挎着长刀走向了林轩。
“哎，这家伙竟然敢在天香坊闹事，恐怕这次是倒霉了！”
“恐怕是新来的，不知道天香坊的厉害……”
林轩望着走来的四名护卫，暗中运转灵力，他没想到一进来会遇到这种情况，但是他绝不是吃亏的主。
正当林轩想发动进攻时，酒爷的声音在他心底响起：“你还是太年轻，这点事情就让你冲动了？”
林轩翻了翻白眼：“都被人欺负到头上了，能不冲动吗！”
酒爷神秘一笑：“看我的！”
林轩感到体内有一股莫名的力量涌出，飘向了那中年胖子。
下一刻，中年胖子一个激灵，然后大声狂笑。
“哈哈，豹哥，这次真是太顺利了，这黑袍人太好坑了，连反抗都没有，他身上的东西咱兄弟俩平分，等我再找只肥羊，到时候在找豹哥你！”
一边说着，中年胖子一边拉住带头护卫，豹哥豹哥的喊个不停。
四周的人一下子便明白了是怎么回事，纷纷怒视天香坊的护卫，原本还想捉拿林轩的四名护卫顿时吓得不停的后退。
那豹哥更是吓得脸色苍白，他抡起手掌，扇了过去。
啪！
中年胖子被打了原地转了三圈，原本就胖的脸如今更是肿的厉害。
这一巴掌彻底将中年胖子打醒了。
“豹，豹哥，你怎么打我？”

中年胖子委屈道。
“滚，老子不认识你！
来人，把这胖子抓起来！”
豹哥恨不得撕了他。
事情闹成这样，早就惊动了天香坊的主人，只见一个穿着粉红色长裙的貌美女子缓缓的走来。
她先是派人把那豹哥压了下去，然后又对四周的人道了声歉，声称这种事情再也不会发生，最后她来到林轩旁边，娇声说道：“这位先生，这次实在是抱歉了，天香坊招待不周，还望先生见谅。”
“为了弥补这次的误会，您这次购买的东西我们天香坊一律按七折出售！”
粉红女子说道。
林轩压低嗓子说道：“贵坊有如此诚意，我在追究也没意思了，不知贵坊可有卖百年灵果的？”
“先生这边请。”
粉红女子笑容如花，扭动着腰肢，带着林轩走进了一间气派的店铺内。
“这是百年火焰果，含有强大的火属性，非常适合修炼火属性武学的武者服用，价格一千灵石。
这是冰霜果，蕴含霸道的冰霜之力……”
粉红女子一连介绍了七八种灵果，每一种都是百年以上，珍贵无比。
“不知道先生看中了哪一种？”
粉红女子笑问道。
林轩目光闪动，这些灵果全都在一千灵石左右，打完七折也是七百灵石左右，他不知道他的灵酒能卖到什么价钱，不过想来应该不会比这些灵果差。
“我要这三个。”
林轩手指伸出，压着嗓子说道。
content_en:
"Master Guard, this guy dares to snatch things from Tianxiangfang. He is obviously challenging the majesty of Tianxiangfang. I hope Master Guard will make the decision for me!"
The middle-aged fat man said with a miserable expression, but there was a cunning light in his eyes.
The leading guard glanced at Lin Xuan and saw that there were no powerful spiritual fluctuations on his body, and then sneered: "Come on, take it!"
After saying that, he winked at the fat man. An imperceptible smile appeared on the middle-aged fat man's lips. At the same time, four Tianxiangfang guards walked toward Lin Xuan with long knives in their hands.
"Hey, this guy dares to cause trouble in Tianxiangfang. I'm afraid he's unlucky this time!"
"I'm afraid I'm new here. I don't know how powerful Tianxiangfang is..."
Lin Xuan looked at the four guards approaching and secretly used his spiritual power. He did not expect to encounter such a situation when he came in, but he was by no means the one who would suffer.
Just when Lin Xuan was about to launch an attack, Jiuye's voice sounded in his heart: "You are still too young. This little thing makes you impulsive?"
Lin Xuan rolled his eyes: "I've been bullied so much, how can I not be impulsive!"
The wine man smiled mysteriously: "Look at me!"
Lin Xuan felt an inexplicable force coming out of his body and drifting towards the fat middle-aged man.
The next moment, the middle-aged fat man got excited and laughed loudly.
"Haha, Brother Bao, it went so well this time. This man in black robe is so tricked that he didn't even resist. We two brothers will share his belongings equally. When I find another fat sheep, I'll be looking for you, Brother Bao!"
As he spoke, the middle-aged fat man grabbed the lead guard, shouting "Brother Bao, Brother Bao" non-stop.
The people around him suddenly understood what was going on, and they all glared at the guards of Tianxiangfang. The four guards who originally wanted to capture Lin Xuan were frightened and kept retreating.
Brother Bao turned pale with fright. He raised his palm and slapped him.
Snap!
The middle-aged fat man was beaten around three times, and his already fat face was now even more swollen.
This slap completely woke up the middle-aged fat man.
"Bao, Brother Bao, why did you hit me?"
The middle-aged fat man said aggrievedly.
"Go away, I don't know you!
Come on, arrest this fat guy! "
Brother Bao wanted to tear him apart.
When things happened like this, the owner of Tianxiangfang was alarmed for a long time. He saw a beautiful woman wearing a pink dress walking slowly.
She first sent someone to suppress Brother Bao, and then apologized to the people around her, claiming that this kind of thing would never happen again. Finally, she came to Lin Xuan and said in a sweet voice: "Sir, I am really sorry this time. Tianxiangfang did not provide good hospitality. I hope you will forgive me."
"In order to make up for this misunderstanding, Tianxiangfang will sell all the items you purchased this time at a 30% discount!"
said the pink woman.
Lin Xuan lowered his voice and said: "Your shop is so sincere, and it's pointless for me to pursue it. I wonder if your shop sells 100-year-old fruit?"
"This way, sir."
The pink woman smiled like a flower, twisted her waist, and led Lin Xuan into a magnificent shop.
"This is a century-old flame fruit. It contains powerful fire attributes and is very suitable for warriors who practice fire-attribute martial arts. It costs one thousand spirit stones.
This is the Frost Fruit, which contains the domineering power of frost..."
The pink woman introduced seven or eight kinds of spiritual fruits in succession, each of which was more than a hundred years old and extremely precious.
"I wonder which one sir is interested in?"
the pink woman asked with a smile.
Lin Xuan's eyes flashed. These spiritual fruits were all about one thousand spiritual stones, and after 30% discount, they were still about seven hundred spiritual stones. He didn't know what price his spiritual wine could be sold for, but he thought it should not be worse than these spiritual fruits.
"I want these three."
Lin Xuan stretched out his fingers and said in a low voice.
